title: Senior AI Technical Advisor
description:
We need an experienced engineer to guide the direction, design the approach, and review key milestones for our AI agent project. The work includes planning the program, improving data extraction, and helping build a knowledge base to support the system. You will help ensure the solution is well-structured, efficient, and aligned with our goals from the start.

We are two consultancies building a free AI agent that helps nonprofits plan their programs and how they will measure them. It walks users through a three-step planning framework: a theory of change, a logic model, and a logframe (the results table that lists goals, outputs, outcomes, indicators, and assumptions). The pilot focuses on family planning, a field with well-established global indicators and strong professional networks for sourcing and testing.

The questions we need help with
1. Extraction from PDFs. What is the best way to use AI to pull usable content out of messy PDFs? Logframes are usually multi-page tables, theories of change are often diagrams, some files are scanned, and terminology varies a lot between organizations. We want a process our analysts can run and repeat.
2. Whole documents vs. extracted pieces. Our current leaning is to keep whole documents with rich tags, because breaking them apart can lose the logic linking one level to the next. We also need structured data, such as each outcome and the indicators that measure it. How should we balance the two?
3. Data structure. How should we represent the results chain (impact → outcome → output → activity → indicator) and our tags so the data works for the agent? What should our metadata and rules files look like?
4. Vector database. We plan to use a vector database (one that lets the agent search by meaning, not just exact words). We need advice on which one, how to structure it, and hands-on help setting it up.
5. Models, hosting, and cost. Our preference is to build on an existing commercial AI model rather than train our own, likely hosted in Microsoft Azure. We want a sanity check on that and a rough estimate of running costs.
